question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The incorrectly spelt word is 'Superanuation'.
 
• **"Superannuation"** is the **correct spelling **for the term referring to retirement funds. (रिटायरमेंट का निधि)
 
 
• **Example:** Proper planning of superannuation can lead to a comfortable post-retirement life.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Phytoplankton** (सूक्ष्म वनस्पति प्लवक): Microscopic plants that live in watery environments.

 
 
• **Example:** Phytoplankton are crucial for marine ecosystems as they are primary producers.
 
 
 
• **Accentuation** (प्रभाव डालना): The action of emphasizing something.
 
 
• **Example:** The accentuation of her speech made the message very clear to the audience.
 
 
 
• **Suppressant** (दमन करने वाला): A drug or other substance that suppresses an undesirable action or condition.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor prescribed a cough suppressant to alleviate her symptoms.
